Let's catch up on the latest news from the stock market. From significant investments to major deals, quarterly earnings, appointments, and order wins, here’s a quick look at which stocks will be in focus in today's trade:

Stocks to Watch

Peak XV Partners Investments and Sequoia Capital are likely to sell up to 10.02 crore equity shares, representing 1.6 percent of the equity, in the Groww parent via a block deal. The offer size is pegged at Rs 1,918.3 crore, with a floor price of Rs 191.45 per share, reports CNBC-TV18, quoting sources.

Saatvik Green Energy has received an order worth Rs 1,041.63 crore from Solar Energy Corporation of India (SECI) for the supply of solar PV modules.

Sonata Information Technology has signed a five-year Strategic Collaboration Agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to accelerate cloud adoption and modernisation for enterprises across India.

The agreement advances Sonata’s hyperscaler-led growth strategy and expands its ability to address cloud transformation opportunities in the Indian market.

BHEL will form a 50:50 joint venture company (JVC) with Titagarh Rail Systems for the comprehensive maintenance of the supplied Vande Bharat Sleeper Trainsets for 35 years.

The company has received work orders worth Rs 144.98 crore from North Eastern Electric Power Corporation, SAIL, Damodar Valley Corporation and the Enforcement Directorate, Bhubaneswar.

The company has successfully obtained Technical Equivalence approval for one of its insecticide products in the United Kingdom.

Further, it has also successfully obtained registration for one of its herbicide products in Argentina.

W.J. Towell & Co LLC (WJT) has approached the Dubai Court of Appeal seeking annulment of the arbitration award that was issued in favour of Blue Star.

Consequent to the annulment proceedings initiated by WJT, Blue Star will make appropriate submissions before the Dubai Court of Appeal. The company believes that the grounds of annulment raised by WJT are baseless.

WJT, an entity based in Oman, had filed arbitration proceedings against Blue Star before the International Chamber of Commerce. The company had entered into a Shareholders’ Agreement dated October 1, 2015, with WJT for managing the affairs of Blue Star Oman Electro Mechanical Company.

The company had said on July 23, 2026, that the arbitrator had issued an award in favour of Blue Star, dismissing all the claims made by WJT.

Alexander Poempner has resigned as the Group Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of the company, effective November 4, 2026. The Board has appointed Ankit Nayyar as Group CFO of the company, effective the same date.

The Board meeting is scheduled to be held on September 18 to consider a proposal to raise funds, in one or more tranches, through the issuance of equity shares, debt securities and convertible securities.

The United States Food and Drug Administration (US FDA) inspected Unit-II, an API manufacturing facility of the company’s subsidiary Apitoria Pharma in Telangana, from September 7 to 15, 2026.

The US FDA concluded the inspection with one observation, which is procedural in nature.

Tata Communications (TC Canada) and the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) have reached an agreement in principle to settle the issue pertaining to claims for taxes on income arising from the international telecommunications services business of TC Canada.

Balfour Manuel has resigned as Managing Director (MD) of the company, effective November 29, 2026. However, R.S. Subramanian has been appointed as the new MD of the company, effective November 30.

Bulk Deals

Authum Investment & Infrastructure net sold 24.02 lakh shares, representing 1.73 percent of Welspun Enterprises' paid-up equity, for Rs 183.8 crore. The shares were sold at an average price of Rs 765.02 apiece.

Fidelity Securities Fund, through Fidelity Blue Chip Growth Fund, acquired 19.23 lakh shares, representing 1.38 percent of the company's paid-up equity, at Rs 765 per share. The transaction was valued at Rs 147.15 crore.
